description: Station buildings, platform shelters, information signs and SNCF clocks in the style of the former Ouest-Etat railway company (Normandy, Pays de la Loire, Brittany). Station buildings are provided as modules for the modular rail station. The French Platforms mod is recommended for matching passenger platforms.
name: Pack Ouest Etat
summary: French Ouest-Etat style station buildings, platform shelters, signs and clocks.
